Add a new patron record in Koha.
Perform a book checkout using Koha.

slides.title: Exploring a Few Features in Koha
slides.narration:
Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial.
It is on Exploring a Few Features in Koha.
slides.image_prompt: Koha logo with 'Spoken Tutorial' and 'IIT Bombay' branding, on a clean background.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
content: Search the library catalog in Koha.
Add a new patron record in Koha.
Perform a book checkout using Koha.
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to navigate the Koha staff interface.
You will search the library catalog.
You will add a new patron record.
Finally, you will perform a book checkout.
slides.image_prompt: Icons representing navigation, search, adding a user, and checking out a book. All are visually distinct.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
To follow this tutorial, you need a web browser and an internet connection.
You also need access to a Koha installation.
We will use Koha version 22.11 or higher.
slides.image_prompt: Icons for a web browser, internet cloud, and Koha software logo. Arranged horizontally.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
You should have basic computer literacy.
You should also be familiar with web browsing.
No prior Koha knowledge is needed.
slides.image_prompt: A person sitting at a computer, looking comfortable and engaged. Simplified browser icon in the corner.

slides.title: What is Koha?
slides.narration:
Koha is an open-source Integrated Library System.
It helps libraries manage their operations.
Many libraries worldwide use Koha.
It handles cataloging, circulation, and more.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a modern library with books and computers. The Koha logo is subtly integrated or displayed prominently.

slides.title: Logging In to Koha
content: Enter your Koha staff client URL.
slides.narration:
First, open your web browser.
Enter your Koha staff client URL.
Now, type your Username and Password.
Then, click Log in.
This takes you to the staff interface.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of the Koha staff login page with username and password fields.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of opening a browser, typing a sample Koha staff client URL, entering generic username and password, and clicking 'Log in' to access the Koha staff interface dashboard.

slides.title: Searching the Catalog
content: From the main menu, click 'Koha home'.
Use the search bar at the top.
Press Enter or click the Search button.
slides.narration:
Let's start by searching the catalog.
From the main menu, click 'Koha home'.
Locate the search bar at the top.
Type a keyword like 'Python'.
Press Enter or click Search.
Koha displays the results.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of the Koha staff interface dashboard with the search bar highlighted.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording showing navigation to 'Koha home', typing 'Python' into the search bar, pressing Enter, and displaying the search results page.

slides.title: Viewing Search Results
content: Click on a title for more details.
slides.narration:
Review the displayed search results.
Notice the title, author, and availability.
Click on a title for more details.
This shows the item's full record.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of Koha search results page, highlighting a specific result's title, author, and availability.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording showing browsing through the search results, highlighting specific details of an item, and clicking on a title to view its full record page.

slides.title: Adding a New Patron
content: Click on 'Patrons' in the main navigation.
Fill in required fields: First name, Last name, Card number.
slides.narration:
Next, let's add a new patron.
Click on 'Patrons' in the main navigation.
Then, select 'New patron'.
Choose the patron category, for example, 'Adult'.
Fill in required fields like First name, Last name, and Card number.
Finally, click 'Add patron'.
The new patron record is created.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of the 'Add new patron' form in Koha, with required fields highlighted.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording demonstrating navigating to 'Patrons', selecting 'New patron', choosing a sample category (e.g., 'Adult'), filling in sample required fields (First name, Last name, Card number), and clicking 'Add patron' to create the record.

slides.title: Checking Out a Book
content: Click on 'Circulation' in the main navigation.
Scan the patron's barcode or search by name.
slides.narration:
Now, let's check out a book.
Click on 'Circulation' in the main navigation.
Scan the patron's barcode.
Or search for them by name.
Then, scan the book's barcode.
Koha will display checkout details.
Confirm the transaction.
The book is now checked out.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of the Koha circulation page, showing fields for patron and item barcodes.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording showing navigation to 'Circulation', scanning a sample patron barcode (or typing a name), scanning a sample book barcode, and confirming the checkout transaction on the screen.

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you learned to navigate Koha.
You searched the library catalog.
You also added a new patron record.
Finally, you performed a book checkout.
These are essential daily tasks in Koha.
slides.image_prompt: Recap icons for navigation, search, add patron, and checkout, arranged clearly on a summary slide.

slides.title: Assignment
content: Add another new patron with different details.
Search for a book by author's name.
Practice checking out and checking in a book.
slides.narration:
Here is a small assignment for you.
Add another new patron.
Use different details for them.
Search for a book using the author's name.
Practice checking out and checking in a book.
This will help reinforce your learning.
slides.image_prompt: A person at a computer, actively working on the Koha interface, with thought bubbles showing the assignment tasks.
